tires.gone.text: [firm, composed, with controlled urgency] We're out of tire. Box, box.

box.missed.entry.text: [quietly amused, trying to remain professional] ...Alright. Missed pit entry... box next lap.

radiator.bad.text: [firm, composed, speaking with authority] Radiator's badly damaged. Box now. The engine won't last if we stay out.

box.overshot.text: [dry, understated sarcasm] Little past where the crew can reach you. [back to business, matter-of-fact] You overshot the box, so no stop. Come in again next lap.

engine.critical.text: [firm, composed, speaking with authority] Water temp's critical. It won't take much more. Box, or back RIGHT off.

engine.hot.text: [calm, conversational, taking the problem seriously] Engine's running hot, and we're down on power. Lift and coast where you can.

radiator.hit.text: [slightly concerned, calm and focused] We've hurt the radiator. Water temps are going to climb... lift early, short-shift, and stay out of the tow.

gearbox.hit.text: We've hurt the gearbox. Shifts are slow now... be gentle with it.

gearbox.bad.text: [calm, matter-of-fact, with a faintly wry edge] Gearbox isn't real happy. It's missing shifts. Short-shift it... no big downshifts.

gearbox.overrev.text: [firm, calm, correcting without scolding] Easy on those downshifts. You're over-revving it, and the gearbox is taking the damage.

gearbox.lost.1.text: [firm, composed, giving a clear update] First gear's gone. It'll skip that gear now.

gearbox.lost.2.text: [firm, composed, giving a clear update] Second gear's gone. It'll skip that gear now.

gearbox.lost.3.text: [firm, composed, giving a clear update] Third gear's gone. It'll skip that gear now.

gearbox.lost.4.text: [firm, composed, giving a clear update] Fourth gear's gone. It'll skip that gear now.

gearbox.lost.5.text: [firm, composed, giving a clear update] Fifth gear's gone. It'll skip that gear now.

gearbox.lost.6.text: [firm, composed, giving a clear update] Sixth gear's gone. It'll skip that gear now.

gearbox.lost.7.text: [firm, composed, giving a clear update] Seventh gear's gone. It'll skip that gear now.

floor.hit.text: We've damaged the floor and lost some rear downforce. Watch it in the fast corners.

wing.front.hit.text: Front wing's damaged. That's cost us some downforce.

floor.bad.text: [slightly concerned, calm and focused] Floor's damaged. We've lost rear downforce, so it'll be loose in the fast stuff. Box when you can.

wing.rear.hit.text: Rear wing's damaged. That's cost us some downforce.

wing.rear.gone.text: [focused, controlled urgency, keeping the instruction clear] Rear wing's gone. Box for a new one.

wing.front.gone.text: [focused, controlled urgency, keeping the instruction clear] Front wing's gone. Box for a new one.

suspension.hit.text: We've hurt the suspension. The car's going to pull, and it'll cost us some pace.

suspension.bent.fl.text: [calm, focused, explaining the handling change] Front left suspension's bent. The car will pull, and that tire will scrub. Box to get it fixed.

suspension.bent.fr.text: [calm, focused, explaining the handling change] Front right suspension's bent. The car will pull, and that tire will scrub. Box to get it fixed.

tires.fading.text: Tires are starting to give up some grip. Bring it in when you can.

suspension.bent.rl.text: [calm, focused, explaining the handling change] Rear left suspension's bent. The car will pull, and that tire will scrub. Box to get it fixed.

box.plan.medium.text: [firm, composed, clear and decisive] Box, box. Mediums this lap.

box.plan.soft.text: [firm, composed, clear and decisive] Box, box. Softs this lap.

suspension.bent.rr.text: [calm, focused, explaining the handling change] Rear right suspension's bent. The car will pull, and that tire will scrub. Box to get it fixed.

box.plan.wet.text: [firm, composed, clear and decisive] Box, box. Wets this lap.

box.plan.hard.text: [firm, composed, clear and decisive] Box, box. Hards this lap.

box.pastgarage.text: [calm, conversational, a little bemused] You've gone past the garage. Bring it in next lap.

box.missed.entry.2.text: [quietly amused, holding back a smile] Yeah... pit road was back there. Box next lap.

box.penalty.text: [patient, matter-of-fact] Penalty first. Once that's served, the crew goes to work.

box.doublestack.text: We're double stacking. You'll be in behind your teammate... expect a wait at the box.

call.rain.text: Rain's starting. Want to go to wets now?

call.drying.text: Track's drying out. Want slicks now?

call.rain.hard.text: [slightly concerned, calm and focused] Rain's coming down hard. Want wets now?

call.drying.fast.text: [focused, conversational, weighing the opportunity] Track's drying fast. Want to go to slicks now?

call.whofirst.mate.text: Copy. Teammate first, then you box next lap.

call.whofirst.text: You're both due a stop. Who are we bringing in first, you or your teammate?

call.vsc.text: [thoughtful, calm, quietly confident] VSC's out. A stop costs half right now.

call.cover.text: Car behind has stopped. Want to box now and stay ahead?

call.sc.text: [thoughtful, calm, quietly confident] Safety car's out. A stop costs us a lot less now.

call.undercut.text: [focused, conversational, weighing the opportunity] Car ahead's close, and they're due a stop too. Want to box now for the undercut?

call.swap.text: You've got more pace than your teammate. Want me to ask them to let you by?

call.letby.text: Your teammate's quicker and right on you. Want to let them by?

call.raceit.text: [relaxed, confident, with a gentle reminder] Copy, we'll race them. Keep it clean.

call.letthrough.text: [firm, composed, speaking with authority] Copy. Let your teammate through.

rain.radar.1.text: We've got rain on the radar. About a lap away.

rain.radar.2.text: We've got rain on the radar. About two laps away.

rain.stopped.text: Rain's stopped now. Track should start drying from here.

vsc.out.text: [firm, composed, speaking with authority] Virtual Safety Car. Bring the speed down and keep your delta positive.

vsc.box.text: [focused, controlled urgency, clear and decisive] VSC's out. Box this lap... good chance for a cheap stop.

sc.out.text: [firm, composed, speaking with authority] Safety car, safety car. Catch the queue. NO overtaking. Pit lane's open.

sc.fromvsc.text: [firm, composed, clear and steady] VSC's become a full safety car. Catch the queue, no overtaking. Pit lane's open.

sc.passed.text: [focused, controlled urgency, speaking with authority] You've passed the safety car. Lift now and let it back past.

pen.drivethrough.text: [firm, composed, giving precise instructions] We've got a drive-through penalty. Through the pits in the next three laps... no stop allowed.

mate.out.engine.text: [low-key, matter-of-fact, delivering unwelcome news] Teammate's out of the race. Engine's gone.

flag.blackorange.text: [focused, controlled urgency, giving precise instructions] Black and orange flag. Box, box. We need a new wing within two laps.

mate.out.gearbox.text: [low-key, matter-of-fact, delivering unwelcome news] Teammate's out of the race. Gearbox failure.

mate.out.crash.text: [subdued, calm and professional] Teammate's out of the race. They've crashed.

fail.oil.text: [slightly concerned, calm and focused] We're losing oil pressure. Need you to nurse it.

fail.engine.temps.text: [slightly concerned, calm and focused] Engine temps are starting to climb.

fail.gearbox.noise.text: [attentive, calm, with restrained concern] Gearbox is starting to sound rough.

fail.gearbox.slow.text: Shifts are starting to get slow on us.

fail.brakes.text: [slightly concerned, calm and focused] Brake temps are very high now.

fail.rear.loose.text: [attentive, calm, with restrained concern] We've got something loose at the rear.

prac.minisec.done.text: [pleased, understated, quietly confident] That's the job done. Your practice bests are on the board for qualifying.

prac.minisec.lap.text: Nice, more targets beaten on that lap. Keep at it.

prac.acclim.done.text: [pleased, relaxed, getting back to business] That takes care of it. Brake points are marked for the weekend.

prac.acclim.best.text: [pleased, understated, with a small smile] There we go. Best one yet.

prac.acclim.ok.text: Good lap. That'll do the job.

prac.acclim.short.text: [encouraging, calm, giving a practical correction] Not quite there yet. Get the speed right in the red gates.

track.spa.welcome.text: [warm, confident, building a sense of occasion] Welcome to Spa-Francorchamps! Over four miles through the Ardennes forest... and one of the great racetracks on the planet. | [warm, appreciative, natural Southern drawl] And that climb through Eau Rouge... you feel that one in your stomach. Quite a sight from up here, too.

track.monaco.welcome.text: [polished, measured, warm] Welcome to Monaco. Tight city streets, barriers close by... and very little room for a mistake. | [after a beat, thoughtful, natural drawl] You spend the whole lap wishing you had another inch. And when you're stuck behind somebody, it feels even narrower.

track.suzuka.welcome.text: [warm, admiring, conversational broadcast rhythm] Welcome to Suzuka! A figure-eight circuit with a wonderful rhythm... and very little room to get that rhythm wrong. | [engaged, knowing, easy drawl] Those Esses will keep you busy. Get a little out of shape through the first one, and you're still sorting it out two corners later.

cond.day.clear.text: [bright, upbeat, easy broadcast rhythm] Sunshine and blue skies today, and the track temperature is climbing. | [conversational, explaining like a driver] Hot track eats tires. Look after 'em early... or you'll be sliding all over the place at the end.

track.laguna.welcome.text: [relaxed, professional, with a hint of a smile] Welcome to Laguna Seca, up in the hills of Monterey, California. Eleven turns... and one very famous corner. | [conversational, knowing, a small smile] The Corkscrew. You turn in before you can see much of what's below you... takes a little getting used to.

track.haruna.welcome.text: [intrigued, a little hushed, atmospheric] Mount Haruna. No grandstands, no pit lane... just a mountain road, and a whole lot of hairpins on the way down. | [thoughtful, quietly experienced] And on the way down, it's awful easy to ask too much of the brakes. You want a little patience here... even when that road's tempting you.

cond.night.text: [anticipatory, atmospheric, a little hushed] Under the lights tonight, and it's a beautiful sight from up here. | [after a beat, warm and nostalgic, then lively] I always loved racing at night. Track cools off, the car's got more grip... and everything feels about twice as fast!

cond.dusk.text: [calm, a little atmospheric] The sun's getting low as we get set to go, and the shadows are stretching across the track. | [knowing, a bit wry] That low sun is tricky. You come over a rise, and it's right in your eyes. Can't see a thing for a second.

cond.overcast.text: [steady, matter-of-fact] Gray skies overhead and cool temperatures this afternoon. | [explaining, folksy] Cool track, you gotta work to get heat in the tires. First couple laps, it's like driving on ice skates.

cond.rain.text: [serious, building concern] And it is WET out there. Rain coming down, and spray everywhere. | [jumping in, half laughing, half dreading it] Oh, I hated this! You can't see the car in front of you. You're aiming at a red light in the spray and hoping!

incident.save.text: [sharply surprised, urgent] Oh, the rear steps out! He's sideways! | [tense, quick bursts] Hang on... hang on... | [relieved, impressed] And he gathers it up. What a save! | [astonished, releasing a small laugh] Man alive. I'd have needed a minute after that.

pass.aggressive.text: [surprised, animated] Oh, he's going for it! Way down on the inside! | [explosive surprise, incredulous] Oh, BUDDY! He just threw that thing in there! | [excited, impressed] And somehow, he makes it stick! | [laughing briefly, admiring] I don't know how he did it... but I like it!

intro.standard.text: [warm, professional, building anticipation] Well, we've got a packed grandstand, a full field, and every one of these drivers thinks they can win this thing! | [playful, natural Southern drawl, chuckling] Well, I'll tell ya what, buddy... they might all THINK they can win. Most of 'em are fixin' to find out otherwise. | [laughing warmly] Well, that's one way to look at it! | [suddenly animated, rising in pitch] Aw, come on now, you know I'm right! Let's go racin'!

finish.close.text: [intensely excited, rapidly building energy] Here they come! Side by side, heading for the checkered flag! | [jumping in, burst of exhilaration, rising in pitch] Come ON! Who's it gonna be?! | [explosive, triumphant, clear] At the line... he gets him! Unbelievable! | [astonished, laughing with excitement] Oh, man! That's racin' right there!

quiet.mirrors.text: [curious, relaxed] How much do you think about the car behind when the gap gets that small? | [knowing, unhurried drawl] More than you ought to. I used to look in that mirror so much, I nearly forgot there was a corner in front of me. | [smiling, gently teasing] Nearly? | [brief laugh] We're gonna leave it at nearly.

moment.wouldve.text: [dry, observant] Bold move there. | [confident, amused] I would've tried that pass. | [dry, a small smile] Yes. That's what concerns me. | [surprised chuckle, affectionate] Aw, you're not gonna let me have that one, are ya?

intro.championship.text: [authoritative, restrained, gradually building] It all comes down to this. A whole season of racing... and one afternoon left to settle it. | [sober, quietly experienced] I've sat in that car on a day like this. You tell yourself it's just another race. It ain't. Your hands know it ain't.

start.approaching.text: [focused, gradually building anticipation] Here they come, lined up two by two... and we're just about ready. | [leaning in, quietly intense] Right now every one of 'em is staring at the car in front. Nobody's thinking about turn one yet. They will be in about five seconds.

intro.standard.2.text: [relaxed, warm, conversational] Good to be back with you. Plenty to talk about today, and plenty of drivers with something to prove. | [easy drawl, knowing] Something to prove can make you try a little too hard. I brought plenty of that to the track. | [gently teasing, a small smile] You learned to leave some of it at home? | [small chuckle, self-deprecating] Eventually. Took a while.

start.green.text: [sudden burst of excitement, powerful but clear] And there's the green flag! We are underway! | [jumping in, delighted] Here we go!

start.green.2.text: [excited, classic American broadcast rhythm] Green flag! Let's go racing! | [jumping in, laughing] Hang on, everybody!

start.chaos.text: [surprised, animated, speaking quickly] And they're three wide already, heading into turn one! | [jumping in, rising in pitch] Ain't room for three in there! Somebody's gotta lift... and nobody wants to be first!

pass.clean.text: [impressed, controlled] A beautiful run off the corner. And he's through. | [warm, appreciative] That's patience right there. He waited for a run he could actually do something with.

pass.failed.text: [interested, then a little deflated] He had a look there... couldn't quite get alongside. | [knowing, conversational] He just didn't have the run. Wanted that opening a little more than the car did.

battle.sidebyside.text: [building excitement, rhythmic] Side by side down the straight... and neither one's giving an inch. | [delighted, quick] Oh, I love this. Door to door, and both of 'em know exactly where the other one is. That's trust, right there.

battle.defense.text: [engaged, conversational] Covering the inside again. Making it awfully hard to find a way by. | [chuckling, experienced] Make 'em go the long way around. I used to do that... and make 'em mad doin' it. | [dry, small smile] I don't doubt that for a second.

battle.closing.text: [observant, focused] He's closing that gap in a hurry... and the car ahead knows it. | [easy drawl, then sharpening] Oh, he knows it. You see a car get bigger in that mirror every lap, it starts to feel like it's sittin' in the passenger seat.

battle.stuck.text: [observant, conversational] He's really having to work that car off the corners, trying to find a way by. | [thoughtful, experienced] Yeah, he's waiting on it to settle down. And every second you wait feels about ten seconds long when you're chasing somebody. | [engaged, warm] A tough place to be, when you can see the car you're trying to catch.

incident.offtrack.text: [surprised, then composed] Oh, he's missed the corner completely. Back on track now. | [dryly amused, small chuckle] Well... that's one way to get a better look at the scenery. | [briefly amused, settling back] Unfortunately, it's cost him a couple of spots.

incident.spin.text: [sharply surprised, then composed] Oh, around he goes! Gets it pointed the right way again. | [calm, explaining from experience] Got in there a little hot, and the rear just let go. Once it steps out that far, you're a passenger. Good job keeping it off the wall.

incident.crash.relief.text: [relieved, warm] And the driver is out of the car. | [softened, sincere] Boy, that's good to see.

incident.crash.text: [shocked, clear, genuinely concerned] Hard into the wall. That is a heavy impact. | [sober, direct] It certainly is. Let's hope we see him climb out.

incident.multicar.text: [urgent, clear] Trouble in the corner! Several cars involved! | [jumping in, urgent] Nowhere to go! When it happens right in front of you, you just grab the wheel and hope.

finish.finallap.text: [building anticipation, authoritative] One lap to go. | [quiet, intense] That mirror's getting an awful lot of his attention right now.

finish.win.text: [triumphant, warm, clear] And there's the checkered flag! What a drive! | [delighted, warm drawl] Oh, that's a good one. That's gonna feel real good for a long time.

finish.dominant.text: [warm, reflective, sincerely impressed] A commanding performance. Nobody had an answer today. | [matter-of-fact, admiring] He made that look easy. Keeping it that tidy all afternoon takes some doing.

finish.upset.text: [genuinely astonished, excited] Would you believe it?! Against all the odds... he's done it! | [laughing, incredulous] I did NOT have that one on my card this morning! | [dry, a small smile] Nobody did.

finish.reflect.text: [warm, reflective] There were plenty of times today when that win looked a long way off. | [sincere, quietly proud] He stayed with it. That's what I love about that drive. He just kept giving himself another chance.

quiet.gap.text: [relaxed, conversational] A little breathing room for the leader now. | [easy drawl, knowing] Little bit. I never trusted breathing room till I could see the checkered flag. | [lightly amused] You weren't much for relaxing, were you? | [chuckling, matter-of-fact] Not while somebody behind me was havin' a better afternoon.

quiet.tires.text: [observant, conversational] Tires starting to fall away now. You can see the cars moving around a little more. | [explaining like a driver] You feel it first on the way in. The front starts pushing... then the back wants to come around on you on the way out.

quiet.pitwindow.text: [interested, a little quicker] Pit window's open. Now it gets interesting. | [thoughtful, matter-of-fact] In the car, you're just waitin' on that call. Every lap feels about a mile longer.

quiet.rain.text: [observant, slightly concerned] Clouds building out there. Rain's not far away. | [concerned, drawl] First few drops are the worst. Track gets greasy, and you can't trust a thing.

quiet.early.text: [relaxed, warm] Long way to go yet. | [calm, a little folksy] My old crew chief used to say, you can't win it on the first lap. But you sure can lose it.

moment.closecall.text: [sharply surprised] Oh, that was close! | [relieved, incredulous chuckle] Hoo, boy. I'd still be holding my breath.

moment.ambitious.text: [considering, mildly doubtful] I wonder if he might have been better off waiting another corner. | [friendly, animated] Maybe. But when you see a little daylight, it's awful hard to tell your right foot to be patient. | [dryly amused] That sounds like experience talking. | [chuckling, self-deprecating] Experience... and a couple of unhappy crew chiefs.

moment.surprise.text: [pleasantly surprised, genuinely impressed] Well, look who's joined the party! He's been quietly working his way forward. | [delighted, easy drawl] Nobody was watching him, and that's just how he likes it.

quiet.chat.3.text: [observant, conversational] We talk about speed, but it still comes back to those tires. | [matter-of-fact, experienced] You can have all the power you want. If you can't put it on the road, it won't help you much.

quiet.chat.2.text: [curious] Did you have a superstition before a race? | [easy drawl] Left glove first. Every time. Forgot once and spun on the warm-up lap. | [dryly amused, a small smile] One race was all the evidence you needed? | [chuckling, easy drawl] Plenty for me.

quiet.chat.1.text: [curious, relaxed] What's the hardest part of a long race, from the driver's seat? | [thoughtful, easy drawl] Keeping your mind where it belongs. You get into a rhythm, and then you start thinking about everything except the next corner. | [lightly amused, curious] And what did you tell yourself? | [small laugh, self-deprecating] Mostly, "Pay attention. You've still got to drive this thing."

quiet.chat.4.text: [gently teasing, familiar] Patience didn't come naturally to you, did it? | [knowing, lightly self-deprecating] I was quick before I was patient. Took a few expensive afternoons to put the two together.

quiet.chat.5.text: [curious] What do you actually listen for in the car? | [quietly experienced] Everything. The engine, the tires, the wind... you hear a new noise and your stomach drops before your brain catches up.

quiet.chat.6.text: [amused] I'm told you once ran out of fuel on the last lap. | [sighs] Coasted across the line in second. My crew chief didn't talk to me for a week. | [dry] Just the one week? | [chuckling] He was a forgiving man.

quiet.chat.7.text: [thoughtful, conversational] You put a lot of trust in the people on that radio. | [serious, plainspoken] You do. They're watching things you can't, and you need them to be clear. A familiar voice helps, too.

quiet.chat.8.text: [observant, engaged] Fast corners always look different from up here. | [knowing drawl, measured] Sure do. In the car, you want confidence in what it's going to do next. Bravery only gets you so far.

quiet.chat.9.text: [warm, familiar] You were racing long before anybody was paying you to do it. | [nostalgic] Go-kart, eight years old, a grass track behind the church. Beat my cousin, and I never got over it. | [amused] Did your cousin? | [laughing] Nope.

quiet.chat.10.text: [relaxed] You always said the start was your favorite part. | [delighted, recalling the feeling] That first run toward the corner... I loved it. All that waiting, and suddenly you're right in the middle of it.

quiet.chat.11.text: [dry, teasing] You've been quiet for a minute. Should I be worried? | [easy] Just watching. You learn more watching than talking. | [dry] That'd be a first for this booth. | [laughing] Well, don't get used to it.

quiet.chat.13.text: [curious] Does the car feel different on a cool day? | [conversational, recalling the feeling] Oh, yeah. Some mornings the car would feel wonderful, and I'd still be asking those tires to wake up.

quiet.chat.12.text: [warm, lightly amused] You've quoted that old advice plenty of times: slow in, fast out. | [wry, easy drawl] And I spent five years saying it before I actually did it.

quiet.chat.14.text: [observant] Setup can make or break a weekend. | [wry drawl] You can be the best driver here, and if the car won't turn, you're just a passenger with opinions.

quiet.chat.15.text: [observant] It's tough to follow closely at these speeds. | [thoughtful, experienced] You're trying to get close without spoiling your own run. Sometimes a little space buys you a better chance at the next corner.

quiet.chat.17.text: [thoughtful, conversational] You've always liked the drivers who make it look uneventful. | [plainspoken, admiring] A great lap gets your attention. Doing it again and again, even when the car's a handful... that's what impresses me.

quiet.chat.16.text: [amused, familiar] You've told me that story about losing your radio mid-race. | [amused, easy drawl] Happened twice. Second time, I didn't notice for ten laps. Best race I ever ran. | [laughing] That says something. | [deadpan] About me, or about the radio?

quiet.chat.18.text: [warm, gently curious] You always looked pretty calm before the big races. | [honest, relaxed] Looked calm, sure. I used to make myself take a breath on the straights. Gave me one thing I could settle down.

quiet.chat.19.text: [teasing] Any rivals you still think about? | [wry, low] One. Never mind who. We still don't sit at the same table. | [dry] I'll make a note for the seating chart.

quiet.chat.20.text: [curious] In the car, what are you actually looking at? | [thoughtful, experienced] Farther ahead than people think. If I caught myself staring at the problem, I'd remind myself to look where I wanted the car to go.

quiet.chat.21.text: [relaxed] People always ask: are the drivers friends? | [warm, knowing] Some of my best friends were the hardest people to pass. Didn't mean I was going to make it easy for them.

quiet.chat.22.text: [gentle] Do you miss it? | [quieter, sincere] Every single weekend. Sitting up here's the next best thing. | [warmly] Glad to have you.

quiet.chat.23.text: [relaxed, familiar] You never seemed in a hurry to show everything you had. | [knowing, self-deprecating] Well, I wanted something left when it mattered. Didn't always manage it, but that was the idea.

quiet.chat.24.text: [curious] The heat in those cars must be brutal. | [conversational, quietly experienced] You'd climb out and realize how hot you'd been. In the car, there's always something else asking for your attention.

quiet.chat.25.text: [curious] Do drivers really watch the scoreboard? | [knowing, conversational] I'd sneak a look when I could. Sometimes you needed it, sometimes you just wanted to see whether all that work was getting you anywhere.

quiet.chat.26.text: [warm] Your first win... what do you remember? | [soft, nostalgic] Not much. The flag, and then my mama crying. Everything in between's gone. | [warmly] That's a good memory to keep.

quiet.chat.27.text: [observant, familiar] You could always tell when a track was changing underneath you. | [thoughtful, experienced] You'd find a little grip in a place that wasn't there earlier. Makes you want to try it again... carefully.

quiet.chat.28.text: [curious] Ever tried one of those racing simulators? | [deadpan] Once. Crashed in the first corner, and the chair didn't even move. Didn't feel right. | [dry] The chair was the problem? | [deadpan] Obviously.

quiet.chat.29.text: [curious] What would you change about racing, if you could? | [animated] More places where you can actually pass. Give me a long straight and a tight hairpin, and I'll give you a show.

quiet.chat.31.text: [curious] Which matters more, the car or the driver? | [wry, experienced] I've won when the car wasn't the best, and lost when it probably was. Helps when both are having a good day.

quiet.chat.30.text: [relaxed, familiar] You used to talk about finding a rhythm. | [easy, almost peaceful] Same brake marker, same turn-in, lap after lap. You stop feeling like you're chasing the car. | [smiling] Almost peaceful. | [laughing] Till somebody shows up in your mirror.

quiet.chat.32.text: [observant] The crews don't get enough credit. | [sincere, appreciative] They don't. You see the driver at the finish, but there's a whole group back there who helped make it happen.

quiet.chat.33.text: [amused] You're smiling. | [sheepish laugh] Can't help it. I still get butterflies watching from up here.

quiet.chat.35.text: [observant] Traffic can make or break a lap. | [knowing, conversational] You've got a good lap going, then you catch somebody at just the wrong place. Hard not to get impatient with that.

quiet.chat.34.text: [curious] Who taught you the most? | [nostalgic] An old guy who ran a dirt track back home. Told me the throttle works both ways. | [curious] What did he mean? | [thoughtful] Sometimes going slower is how you go faster. Took me a while.

quiet.chat.36.text: [gentle] Do you ever think about the risks? | [plainspoken, quiet] You respect them. In the car, I tried to stay with what I could do about it. Some days you'd think a little longer on the drive home.

quiet.chat.37.text: [curious] What does a really good lap feel like? | [soft] Quiet. Everything slows down. You're not driving it so much as letting it happen.

quiet.chat.39.text: [curious] Who finishes strongest today, do you think? | [thoughtful, engaged] Tires might have a say, but I want to see who still looks comfortable when the car gets harder to drive.

quiet.chat.38.text: [teasing] The cars have changed a lot since your day. | [chuckling, playfully offended] Since my day? You make it sound like they hauled mine out of a museum. | [dry, a small smile] I was trying to be polite. | [amused, easy drawl] Keep trying.

quiet.chat.40.text: [curious] What goes through your head on the grid? | [honest, recalling the feeling] The first corner. Where I wanted to be, where I didn't. Then we got moving, and I had something useful to do with all those nerves.

intro.standard.4.text: [warm, professional] Good to be with you. Plenty of storylines heading into this one. | [engaged, easy drawl] That's what I like about race day. You finally get to see how those stories hold up.

intro.standard.5.text: [bright, welcoming] Welcome in, everybody. We are just about ready to go racing. | [eager] I've been ready since breakfast.

intro.standard.3.text: [warm, welcoming] Welcome back, everybody. Glad you could join us. | [easy drawl, warmly eager] I've been looking forward to this one. | [dryly amused] You say that every week. | [small chuckle, sincere] And I mean it every week.

intro.standard.7.text: [warm] Welcome along. This one has all the makings of a good race. | [deadpan] I don't make predictions anymore. | [dry] Since when? | [deadpan] Since the last one.

intro.standard.6.text: [warm, building] Hello again, everyone. A full field, and a lot to play for. | [knowing, warmly engaged] A little patience early, and a little nerve when it counts. I always liked that combination.

intro.standard.8.text: [measured, warm] Thanks for joining us. The cars are lined up, and the drivers are strapped in. | [sympathetic, knowing] That waiting used to get me. Once the car started moving, I felt a whole lot better.

intro.standard.9.text: [warm, inviting] Glad you're with us. Let's see what this field has in store today. | [warm, enthusiastic] There's always somebody worth keeping an eye on. That's half the fun.

intro.standard.11.text: [professional, warm] Glad to have you with us. The cars are set, the crews are set. | [sincere, appreciative] That's a lot of work just to get to this point. Now the drivers get to do their part.

intro.standard.10.text: [warm, thoughtful] Here we are again. Another race, and another chance for somebody to make a name for themselves. | [thoughtful, warm] A good afternoon can change a lot for a driver. You never forget the one that gets people talking.

intro.standard.12.text: [bright, quick] Welcome, everybody. Strap in. | [playful, quietly eager] Soon as I put this coffee down, I'm ready.

intro.standard.13.text: [warm, welcoming] Good to have you with us here in the booth. | [delighted, warm] Best seat in the house. | [gently teasing] You used to say that about the driver's seat. | [warm, nostalgic] I did. Some days I still do.

intro.standard.14.text: [warm, building] It's race day, everyone, and we're glad you're here. | [sincere] Never gets old. Thirty years, and I still feel it in my stomach.

intro.opener.text: [warm, building] Welcome to the first race of a brand new season. | [playful, hopeful] Fresh start for everybody. I always liked that feeling.

intro.opener.2.text: [bright, anticipatory] And here we go. A new season starts today. | [chuckling] All winter, everybody's been telling everybody how fast they are. Now we find out.

intro.championship.2.text: [authoritative, building] The last race of the season. Everything still to play for. | [quietly excited, sincere] I still get a little tight in the stomach on a day like this. There's a lot riding on this afternoon.

intro.debut.text: [warm, welcoming] A first race is a big day for any driver. | [warm, nostalgic, easy drawl] I remember mine. Checked the belts about five times, just to give my hands something to do. | [amused, gentle] Did it help? | [small chuckle, warm] Not much. Getting started did.

quiet.early.2.text: [relaxed] Plenty of laps left in this one. | [easy drawl] Nobody wins it in the first ten minutes. Plenty have lost it, though.

quiet.early.3.text: [relaxed, observant] Everybody settling in now. | [knowing] First few laps, you're just feeling the car out. Seeing what it'll let you get away with.

quiet.gap.2.text: [observant] The leader has some breathing room now. | [wry] Breathing room's nice. Just don't get comfortable in it.

quiet.tires.2.text: [observant] The tires are starting to fade now. | [explaining] This is where all that patience early on pays you back.

quiet.pitwindow.2.text: [interested] The pit window is open. | [knowing] Every crew's doing math right now. Somebody's math is wrong.

quiet.mirrors.2.text: [observant] Plenty of pressure on the car in front now. | [knowing] You can feel somebody back there without looking. Then you look anyway.

quiet.rain.2.text: [observant, slightly concerned] Some weather heading our way. | [wary drawl] I never liked that first bit of rain. You can't tell how much grip you've got till you don't.

incident.crash.relief.2.text: [relieved] Good news: the driver is out and walking. | [softened] That's the best thing we'll see all day.

start.chaos.2.text: [surprised, quick] And they're three abreast into the first corner! | [laughing] Three cars, room for two. Somebody's about to do some math!

pbp.green.text: [sudden burst of energy] Green flag, and we are racing!

pbp.green.3.text: [rising, thrilled] Here we go! A clean getaway!

pbp.green.5.text: [building, excited] And the field streams down toward the first corner!

pbp.green.7.text: [excited, quick] Off they go, and it is tight already!

pbp.green.8.text: [booming, delighted] Away they go! Let's go racing!

pbp.green.9.text: [quick, alert] Good start, everybody gets away cleanly!

pbp.green.10.text: [excited, rapid] And it's a drag race to the first turn!

pbp.green.11.text: [punchy] The green flag waves, and here they come!

pbp.green.12.text: [warm, building] And we're off. Everybody looking for a gap.

pbp.sbs.2.text: [building] Door to door... neither one lifting!

pbp.sbs.text: [rising] Side by side down the straight!

pbp.pressure.text: [focused] Right on the back of the car ahead now.

pbp.pressure.2.text: [building] The gap is coming down... and fast.

pbp.look.text: [interested] Has a look... can't quite get there.

pbp.look.2.text: [quick] Tries the inside... and the door's shut.

pbp.offtrack.2.text: [quick] Runs wide, and that'll cost a spot or two.

pbp.offtrack.text: [surprised] Off the road... and through the grass!

pbp.crash.text: [shocked] Oh, trouble! Hard into the wall!

pbp.finallap.text: [building, authoritative] There's the white flag! One lap to go!

pbp.finallap.3.text: [building] One lap left in this one!

pbp.pass.2.text: [crisp] Gets the run, and takes the spot!

pbp.pass.text: [building, quick] Down the inside... and through!

pbp.pass.3.text: [impressed] Around the outside! What a move!

pbp.pass.4.text: [quick, rising] Late on the brakes... and makes it stick!

pbp.pressure.3.text: [intense] All over the back of the car in front!
